```{r dont touch this code chunk}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggdist)
library(systemfonts)

nz_births <- read_csv("https://www.massey.ac.nz/~jcmarsha/data/nz/births_tidy.csv") |>
  mutate(cohort = year - age) |> # mothers year of birth
  filter(cohort >= 1948, cohort <= 1980, age < 46)
```

## Your Figure

```{r your figure here}
# update this code
ggplot(nz_births) +
  aes(x=age, y=rev(cohort), thickness=births, group=cohort) +
  geom_slab(height=2)
```
